why: PRINTED: 'You gain Summon Fiend as a 6th-rank innate spell OF A TRADITION OF YOUR CHOICE, which you can cast once per day.' The record carried no `choice`, so the player was never asked and the innate spell took whatever tradition the spell record itself votes for. READER: the picker renders for any feat carrying `choice` (Builder.tsx), and the answer is read back by traditionFromFlag in build.ts, which scans the character's feats for a matching `choice.flag`. The flag is namespaced BECAUSE that scan is global — a bare `tradition` would collide; the only other user today is boneMagicTradition.

Only the TRADITION half changes; rank, usesPerDay and the heightenAt ladder already match the printed text ('At 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the spell is heightened by one rank, to a maximum of 10th rank when you reach 20th level') and are kept exactly as shipped. READER: InnateSpellGrant.traditionFromChoiceFlag (types.ts:1758) is consumed at build.ts:5119, which stamps the chosen tradition onto the granted spell. Two records already use this lane, so it is proven rather than new.
